#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  echo "usage: $0 SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]" >&2
  exit 2
}

[ "$#" -ge 2 ] && [ "$#" -le 3 ] || usage

src=$1
dest=$2
keep=${3:-5}

case $keep in
  ''|*[!0-9]*|0*) usage ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
  echo "error: not a directory: $src" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ -n "${BACKUP_NOW:-}" ]; then
  stamp=$BACKUP_NOW
else
  stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
fi

mkdir -p -- "$dest"
archive="$dest/backup-$stamp.tar.gz"
tar -czf "$archive" -C "$src" .

# Newest first by name; delete every regular archive beyond the first KEEP.
shopt -s nullglob
count=0
printf '%s\n' "$dest"/backup-*.tar.gz | LC_ALL=C sort -r | while IFS= read -r file; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  count=$((count + 1))
  if [ "$count" -gt "$keep" ]; then
    rm -f -- "$file"
  fi
done

printf '%s\n' "$archive"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  echo "usage: $0 SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]" >&2
  exit 2
}

[ "$#" -ge 2 ] && [ "$#" -le 3 ] || usage

src=$1
dest=$2
keep=${3:-5}

case $keep in
  ''|*[!0-9]*|0*) usage ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
  echo "error: not a directory: $src" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ -n "${BACKUP_NOW:-}" ]; then
  stamp=$BACKUP_NOW
else
  stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
fi

mkdir -p -- "$dest"
archive="$dest/backup-$stamp.tar.gz"
tar -czf "$archive" -C "$src" .

# Newest first by name; delete every regular archive beyond the first KEEP.
count=0
printf '%s\n' "$dest"/backup-*.tar.gz | LC_ALL=C sort -r | while IFS= read -r file; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  count=$((count + 1))
  if [ "$count" -gt "$keep" ]; then
    rm -f -- "$file"
  fi
done

printf '%s\n' "$archive"
